title: HarvestCrop
description: An agricultural e-commerce platform connecting farmers and buyers. I led the UI/UX design, database architecture, and full database development and management — covering schema design, relationships, and query optimization using MySQL and PHPMyAdmin.

title: HerbaScan
description: A CNN-based mobile application that identifies herbal plants through the camera using a MobileNetV2 model converted to TFLite for on-device inference. I handled quality assurance — writing test cases, performing functional and regression testing — and produced the project documentation.
